answer: The oasis register is checked at draw time, marble lists the eligible set, and copper seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 47 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 47 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 84 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
